severity.description: Override default severity for specific rules

exclude.description: Rule IDs to exclude from scan

include.description: Glob patterns to include in scan

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from scan

nonProduction.description: Path patterns for non-production files (scripts, diagnostics). Findings in these paths are downgraded to INFO severity.

rulePacks.description: Paths to custom rule pack JSON files

authHelpers.description: Additional auth helper function names to detect (e.g., requireOrganizationAccess, getServerSession)

tenantGuards.description: Additional tenant guard patterns to detect (e.g., validateTenantContext, checkOrganizationAccess)

userScoped.description: Models that are user-scoped (filtered by userId, not organizationId)

global.description: Models that are global (no tenant filtering needed)

tenantScoped.description: Models that are tenant-scoped (must have organizationId or tenantId)

framework.description: Framework hint for source detection patterns

output.description: Default output format when --format is not specified
